title: CHIRP: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Open-Ended Response Evaluation in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: The paper investigates potential LLM-as-a-judge bias by comparing AI-based evaluation preferences (using models like GPT-4V and LLaVA-34B) against human evaluations. It specifically tests whether AI evaluators exhibit a bias toward textual fluency or models with larger LLMs by calculating the average log probability of response tokens to see if the AI judge's preference is merely aligned with higher text probabilities irrespective of the image content.
